title: About Zuri Bags
lead: Women's handbags in the heart of Nairobi's CBD.
intro: Zuri Bags sells women's handbags from shops along Moi Avenue and Tom Mboya Street. Sling bags, tote bags, office bags and clutch bags, including Chrisbella.
